description: EXIT PARAGRAPH (ISO §2023:14.9.14.2 Format 4 / §2023:14.9.14.4 GR6) — a COBOL-2002 structured-procedure exit transferring control to the implicit CONTINUE at the end of the current paragraph; introduced 2002 (the 85 EXIT is only Format 1, §2023:14.9.14.3 SR1).
citation: ISO §2023:14.9.14.2 Format 4 / §2023:14.9.14.4 GR6 — COBOL-2002 structured-exit introduction (VCR has no 85→2002 rows; derived from the 2002 standard)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMEXPAR.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
P1.
    EXIT PARAGRAPH.
    DISPLAY "AFTER".
P2.
    DISPLAY "P2".
    STOP RUN.
